text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's electricity and water minister signed a 171 million dinar power and water plant contract with Swiss and Italian firms.
- Britain's trade with Gulf Arab states increased by 20 percent in the first 11 months of 1996, official data showed.
- Bahrain pledged support for Sudan's national unity security.
- Bahrain has not received any reply from Qatar about its proposals to Gulf Arab states' four-member mediation committee on Manama's border dispute with Doha, an official said.
